stops.notes: Arrive and settle in. Gandan Monastery, Sükhbaatar Square, and the Chinggis Khaan Museum, as arrival time allows.
Collect the SUV in the morning. Look for wild horses toward evening or the following morning.
Explore Elsen Tasarkhai’s dunes and Khögnö Khan’s rocky hills. Optional short camel ride with a local herder.

stops.stay: Secret of the Silk Road · ensuite ger
stops.notes: Erdene Zuu Monastery and the archaeological museum, followed by a comfortable evening.
Waterfall and volcanic landscape. A guided 2–4-hour horse ride, valley walks, and time with our hosts. Join household activities only if invited.
Take the longer approach back via Kharkhorin and the main road. Soak, walk in the forest, and enjoy a full relaxed day.
Stop in Tsetserleg for supplies on the way. Explore Khorgo volcano and the lava landscape. Keep a full lake day for walks, photography, or weather flexibility.
Market, museum, laundry, and a good meal. Shared bathrooms, hot showers, and secure parking.
The longest transfer. Leave early and arrive before dark; enjoy a restful evening.

stops.stay: Comfortable ger camp or Terelj Hotel & Spa
stops.notes: Granite formations, forested valleys, walking, optional riding, and a possible spa upgrade. Keep the stay flexible for festival dates.
Nomads Festival if confirmed dates align, otherwise a final morning in Terelj. Return the SUV. Fly home the next day on a connection that lands in Berlin within our travel window.
